arithmetic: Decimal arithmetic from exact decimal strings; JSON numeric outputs validated through Decimal(str(value)); no binary-float equality assumption.

documentary_provenance.basis: author-supplied primary-source citation and explicit documentary reconciliation
documentary_provenance.scope: Documentary authorization only; no source retrieval or new image/pixel observation in TI2-CLOSEOUT-1.

equation.meaning: The legacy t_physical_seconds name denotes elapsed_from_first_frame_s only; the original equation is retained for existing readers.

physical_time_s.meaning: Historical zero-offset elapsed time from the first video frame, not experimental time relative to front entry.

provenance.meaning: Preserved TI-1 provenance; current author-supplied reconciliation is in documentary_provenance.

time_origin_seconds.meaning: Zero of elapsed video-frame time; experimental origins are condition-specific offsets.

provenance.limitation: The 1.18 s interval is frozen as an approved protocol assertion; TI-1 did not independently locate the original acquisition statement in the supplied documents.
